section.about.content: My name is Pere and I'm a computer engineer. I enjoy programming, designing, and learning new things. Currently, I'm working as a web developer in Barcelona.
section.about.content2: I have experience in web development, mainly in frontend, using AngularJS, Typescript, Node, and Bootstrap. I have also worked with Java, Spring, and Python.

section.rally.title: Rally
section.rally.p1: I'm a co-driver in regularity rallies: events where the goal is not to be the fastest, but the most precise, keeping an exact average speed over specific sections of every stage. As co-driver I take care of navigation, timing and pace calls, working as a team with the driver.
section.rally.p2: I have also taken part twice in the Volkswagen Golf Challenge.
section.rally.magazine: My photo made the cover of Performance VW (July 2026), in the feature on our Volkswagen Golf Challenge adventure in Morocco.
